evaluation_improvement_plan_007.evidence: "5.4.1 Joint development of an improvement plan with objective criteria to measure progress towards stated goals and timelines for achieving these goals." Also, "Whenever a permanent unit member receives a rating on his/her summative evaluation of 'not meeting' or 'growth expected'... the District shall provide the unit member with a Teacher Development Plan to support and assist the unit member during the ensuing school year in improving his/her performance."
